title: Maybe you should learn something
summary: This is a thoughtful piece from Marginalia.nu, a search engine focused on exploring the overlooked corners of the web. The article discusses the importance of continuous learning, particularly in the context of technical skills and knowledge acquisition in an era of information abundance.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of maintaining meaningful learning habits when information is easily accessible but often superficial.
why_valuable: Offers a philosophical perspective on intentional learning and knowledge depth versus surface-level information consumption.
